youtube.title: Use Your Phone as a Presentation Clicker – Free, No App | SlimClick
youtube.description:
How to use your phone as a presentation remote – for free and without installing an app. SlimClick works with PowerPoint, Keynote, Google Slides and PDF on Windows and Mac.

⬇️ Free download: https://slimbitapps.github.io/SlimClick/
🌐 All apps: https://slimbitapps.github.io

Presentation at school or uni and no clicker? Open SlimClick on your laptop, scan the QR code with your phone camera, and a web page opens – that's your remote. Tap "Next" to change slides, see a live preview of the current slide, point with a laser pointer right on the projector, and keep an eye on the timer.

✅ Phone as presentation clicker – no app install on the phone
✅ Works with PowerPoint, Keynote, Google Slides, LibreOffice, Canva and PDF
✅ Live slide preview on your phone
✅ Laser pointer and spotlight on the big screen
✅ Presentation timer – the screen flashes quietly before time runs out
✅ School Wi-Fi blocks it? Built-in phone hotspot guide
✅ Secure: one-time QR code, signed commands, nobody else can take over
✅ 100 % free: no ads, no account, no cloud

⏱️ Chapters
0:00 Walking to your laptop for every slide
0:20 Scan the QR code & tap next
0:33 Live preview & laser pointer
0:50 Timer & school Wi-Fi
1:04 Secure & free download

❓ FAQ
Do I need to install an app on my phone? – No, your phone just opens a web page.
Does it work on school Wi-Fi? – If the network blocks it, use your phone's hotspot – SlimClick explains every step.
Does it use mobile data? – No, the connection stays between your phone and your laptop.
Is it really free? – Yes, completely free, no ads and no account.

SlimClick is a hobby project by SlimBit Apps – small apps that do more and use less. Ideas or questions? Leave a comment or write to SlimBitApps@gmail.com

Imprint / Impressum: https://slimbitapps.github.io/impressum.html
Voice: AI voice (Microsoft Clipchamp)
